row: Hi! Welcome all pet lovers, parents, guardians, and caretakers!  Please join me, Dr. Erica Dickie, Certified Hospice and Palliative Care Veterinarian, as I speak on all topics related to caring for your pets nearing the end of their lives.  After experiencing the devastating loss of my heart pet, Smokey in January 2019, and the feelings of grief and loss that followed, I shifted my career focus from general practice to Animal Hospice & Palliative Care. I starting my own mobile end of life veterinary care practice, Black Creek Mobile Veterinary Services, in Stratford, Ontario, Canada.  We are exclusively devoted to end of life care for pets, including quality of life assessments and consultations; peaceful in-home pet euthanasia and aftercare & memorialization.  Our mission is to honour the bond, the life, and the love shared with your beloved companion animals.
